SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents FROM orders AS o JOIN product AS p ON p.product_id = o.product_id JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE (CAST(substr('2026-09-24', 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CAST(substr(c.birth_date, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) - CASE WHEN substr('2026-09-24', 6, 5) < substr(c.birth_date, 6, 5) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) = 25;

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product AS p ON p.product_id = o.product_id
WHERE c.birth_date > date('2026-09-26', '-26 years')
  AND c.birth_date <= date('2026-09-26', '-25 years');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN product AS p ON p.product_id = o.product_id
WHERE date(o.date) >= date(c.birth_date, '+25 years')
  AND date(o.date) < date(c.birth_date, '+26 years');

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(o.quantity_product * p.price), 0) AS revenue_cents
FROM orders AS o
JOIN product AS p ON o.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE o.date >= '2026-05-01 00:00:00'
  AND o.date < '2026-06-01 00:00:00'
  AND (CAST(strftime('%Y', o.date) AS INTEGER)
       - CAST(strftime('%Y', c.birth_date) AS INTEGER)
       - (strftime('%m-%d', o.date) < strftime('%m-%d', c.birth_date))) = 25;

WHERE o.product_id = 'd'
